title: StuckDetectorConfig
description: Stuck detector configuration for monitoring worker health (§C1). Detects workers that are idle, hung, or retrying the same bead repeatedly.

idle_timeout_secs.description: Idle timeout: no events, any type, for N seconds (default: 180 = 3 minutes)

max_runtime_secs.description: Hard ceiling on total turn duration regardless of activity (default: 3600 = 1 hour)

content_seen_grace_secs.description: Extended idle tolerance once real content appeared (default: 600 = 10 minutes)

heartbeat_transition_threshold_secs.description: No heartbeat state transition (Live<->Hung) for N seconds (default: 300 = 5 minutes)

retry_threshold.description: Maximum retry attempts on the same bead before alerting (default: 3)
